paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.86 as of July 29, representing a 6.69 percent decrease from the prior close and a 36.03 percent decrease over the last 21 trading sessions. There have been 2 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include Fermi America closing 350 million dollars in financing to support its power and data center platform, as reported by MSN, and Texas Capital Securities reiterating a Buy rating on Fermi shares with a 23.00 dollar price target, as reported by Investing.

There have been various SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of 431.25 million dollars in aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2031. There has been one Form 4 filing and four new social posts in the last 24 hours, including a discussion thread about Fermi America and a post mentioning FRMI as a good stock for long term swings.
